sentences.text: Mr. R. R. Vyas, Advocate for applicant.
Mr. N.R. Rode, App for non-applicant No.1/State.
Coram: Vinay Joshi And Valmiki Sa Menezes Jj.

2. This application is seeking to quash First Information Report ('FIR') vide crime No. 269/2023 for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 406 of the Indian Penal Code registered with Police Station Ambazari, Nagpur.
3. The learned counsel appearing for the applicant submits that the contents of FIR are totally false.
There was no transaction of sale of flat, but in-fact, it was money lending transaction in between them.
To substantiate said contention, applicant took us through legal notices issued by the informant which only speaks about hand loan and not about assurance to sell flat as alleged.
On that basis, it is canvassed that already, the informant has initiated proceeding under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act and thus, there is no aspect of cheating.
According to him, the money lending transaction would at the most amenable to civil action to pressurize the 2 11apl795.23 applicant, the criminal prosecution has been lodged.
4. Issue notice to the non-applicants returnable after four weeks.
